_meta.purpose: Curated supplement to the scraped Task 1 dataset (bis_standards_dataset.json), which is heavily skewed to civil/mechanical standards. These rows fill the product categories the demo needs: electrical cables, LPG cylinders, toys, drinking water, IT/electronics, jewellery, plus current editions of a few flagship civil standards.
_meta.merge_behaviour: Loaded on top of the primary dataset and deduplicated by base number + part. Where a row here overlaps a scraped row (e.g. IS 1786), the richer text wins and the other number format is kept in also_known_as.
_meta.accuracy_note: source_confidence 'high' means the standard number, title and year were checked against a bis.gov.in document during curation (see verified_reference). 'medium' means the number and subject are believed correct but the exact edition year was not confirmed. Anything shown in the live demo should still be spot-checked against the BIS catalogue.

standards.title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor for Rated Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
standards.scope_description: Specification for PVC insulated unsheathed and sheathed electrical cables and flexible cords with copper or aluminium conductors for rated voltages up to and including 1100 volts, used in internal building wiring, submains and appliance connection. Covers conductor construction, insulation and sheath thickness, conductor resistance, insulation resistance, high voltage test, flammability and core identification colours.

standards.title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
standards.scope_description: Specification for heavy duty PVC insulated electric power and control cables, armoured and unarmoured, with copper or aluminium conductors for working voltages up to and including 1100 volts, used in distribution networks, panel feeders and industrial installations. Covers conductor and armour construction, insulation and sheath, electrical tests and dimensional tolerances.

standards.title: Conductors for Insulated Electric Cables and Flexible Cords - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for annealed copper, tinned copper and aluminium conductors used in insulated electric cables and flexible cords, covering conductor classes, nominal cross sectional areas, number and diameter of wires, maximum conductor resistance at 20 degrees Celsius and flexibility requirements. This is the raw material standard normatively referenced by cable specifications.

standards.title: PVC Insulation and Sheath of Electric Cables - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for polyvinyl chloride compounds used as insulation and sheathing material for electric cables, covering compound types, tensile strength and elongation before and after ageing, loss of mass, hot deformation, heat shock, thermal stability and insulation resistance constants. Referenced as a material standard by PVC cable specifications.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Cables
standards.scope_description: Multi-part standard prescribing the test methods used for electric cables, including measurement of conductor resistance, insulation thickness and dimensions, insulation resistance, high voltage tests, tensile and elongation tests on insulation and sheath, hot set test, ageing in air oven, loss of mass, heat shock, thermal stability and flammability tests.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
standards.scope_description: Code of practice covering design, selection, erection, inspection and testing of electrical wiring installations in buildings for voltages not exceeding 1100 V. Includes circuit arrangement and protection, cable selection and current carrying capacity, voltage drop, earthing of installations, segregation of circuits, and safety precautions during installation and maintenance.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Earthing
standards.scope_description: Code of practice for earthing of electrical installations and equipment, covering earth electrode types and design, soil resistivity measurement, sizing of earthing and bonding conductors, earthing of substations and generating stations, equipotential bonding, and protective earthing for safety of persons against electric shock.

standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250 V and Rated Current up to and Including 16 A - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for plugs and socket outlets for household and similar general purpose use rated up to 250 volts and 16 amperes. Covers dimensions and interchangeability, protection against electric shock, insulation resistance and electric strength, temperature rise, breaking capacity, normal operation, mechanical strength, flexible cable anchorage and resistance to heat, fire and tracking.

standards.title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Gas Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litres Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases, Part 1: Cylinders for Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for welded low carbon steel gas cylinders exceeding 5 litres water capacity for storage and transport of liquefied petroleum gas, covering design and wall thickness calculation, materials, welding and construction, valve pad and bung, protective ring or grill and shroud, hydrostatic stretch and burst testing, protective coating, marking and periodic retesting. Sixth revision.

standards.title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases Not Exceeding 5 Litre Water Capacity - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for small welded low carbon steel cylinders of water capacity not exceeding 5 litres for low pressure liquefiable gases, covering materials, design and construction, valve fitting arrangement, hydrostatic and pneumatic testing, protective finish and marking. Applies to the small LPG cylinders used for portable and camping stoves.

standards.title: Valve Fittings for Use with Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Cylinders of More Than 5 Litre Water Capacity - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for self closing valve fittings used on liquefied petroleum gas cylinders of water capacity above 5 litres, covering materials for valve body and spindle, design and dimensions, gauging, leak tightness, endurance and torque testing, and marking requirements for domestic and commercial LPG cylinder service.

standards.title: Liquefied Petroleum Gases - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for commercial liquefied petroleum gases supplied as fuel, covering the grades of LPG, vapour pressure limits, volatility, copper strip corrosion, total volatile sulphur content, moisture and residue on evaporation, together with the sampling and test methods to be used for acceptance of bulk and cylinder supplies.

standards.title: Safety of Toys, Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
standards.scope_description: Safety requirements for the mechanical and physical properties of toys intended for use by children, covering small parts and choking hazards, sharp edges and sharp points, projectiles and kinetic energy limits, cords and elastics, folding mechanisms, enclosures and confined spaces, stability and overload, and the stricter requirements applying to toys for children under 36 months, with the associated test methods.

standards.title: Safety of Toys, Part 2: Flammability
standards.scope_description: Requirements and test methods for the flammability of toys, specifying categories of flammable materials prohibited in toys, and the rate of spread of flame tests applied to toys to be worn on the head, toy disguise costumes, toys intended to be entered by a child, and soft filled toys.

standards.title: Safety of Toys, Part 3: Migration of Certain Elements
standards.scope_description: Test method and maximum acceptable limits for the migration of the toxic elements antimony, arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury and selenium from toy materials and parts of toys, including preparation of samples of coatings, polymers, textiles, paper and modelling materials, extraction simulating ingestion, and analytical determination.

standards.title: Safety of Electric Toys - Specification
standards.scope_description: Safety requirements for toys incorporating at least one electric function, including battery operated and transformer operated toys, covering markings and instructions, power input, heating and abnormal operation, electric strength and insulation resistance, mechanical strength, protection against access to live parts, construction of transformers and batteries, and screws and connections.

standards.title: Drinking Water - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification prescribing acceptable and permissible limits for the physical, chemical, toxic substance, radioactive and bacteriological parameters of drinking water supplied by piped supply, tanker or other means. Covers colour, odour, turbidity, pH, total dissolved solids, total hardness, chloride, sulphate, nitrate, fluoride, iron, arsenic, lead, mercury, pesticide residues, total coliform and E coli.

standards.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for packaged drinking water other than natural mineral water, covering permitted source and treatment processes, limits for organoleptic, physical, chemical, pesticide residue, toxic substance and microbiological parameters, requirements for the packaging material, hygienic conditions of manufacture, sampling, and labelling of bottled drinking water offered for sale.

standards.title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for packaged natural mineral water obtained from a protected underground or surface source, covering permitted treatments, limits for physical, chemical, toxic substance, pesticide residue and microbiological parameters, mineral content declaration, packaging material, hygiene during bottling, sampling and labelling.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater, Part 1: Sampling
standards.scope_description: Test method covering procedures for sampling water and wastewater for physical and chemical examination, including selection of sampling points, grab and composite samples, types and cleaning of sample containers, minimum sample volume, preservation techniques and holding times, transport, and records required for a representative and defensible analytical result.

standards.title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety, Part 1: General Requirements
standards.scope_description: Safety requirements for mains and battery powered information technology and business equipment, including laptops, tablets, desktop computers, monitors, printers, scanners and power supply units. Covers protection against electric shock and energy hazards, insulation and clearances, fire enclosures and flammability, thermal limits, mechanical strength and stability, and hazardous radiation. Notified under the Compulsory Registration Scheme for electronics and IT goods.

standards.title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements
standards.scope_description: Safety requirements for mains operated audio, video and similar electronic apparatus such as televisions, monitors used as televisions, set top boxes, amplifiers and powered speaker systems. Covers marking and instructions, protection against electric shock, insulation and creepage distances, stability and mechanical hazards, resistance to fire, and component requirements. Notified under the Compulsory Registration Scheme.

standards.title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Safety Requirements for Portable Sealed Secondary Cells and Batteries Made from Them, for Use in Portable Applications, Part 2: Lithium Systems
standards.scope_description: Safety requirements and tests for portable sealed lithium ion and lithium polymer cells and battery packs used in mobile phones, laptops, power banks and portable electronic equipment. Covers electrical abuse tests including external short circuit, abnormal charging and forced discharge, mechanical abuse tests including crush, impact and vibration, thermal abuse, and design and construction requirements. Notified under the Compulsory Registration Scheme.

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances, Part 1: General Requirements
standards.scope_description: General safety requirements for household and similar electrical appliances, covering classification, marking and instructions, protection against access to live parts, starting and input, heating and temperature rise limits, leakage current and electric strength at operating temperature, moisture resistance, overload and abnormal operation, stability and mechanical hazards, construction, internal wiring, earthing provision, screws and connections, and clearances and creepage distances.

standards.title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking
standards.scope_description: Requirements for the grading of gold and gold alloys used in jewellery and artefacts by fineness expressed in carats and parts per thousand, including the 14, 18 and 22 carat grades covered by mandatory hallmarking, the marks to be applied under the BIS hallmarking scheme, permissible tolerance on declared fineness, and sampling of finished jewellery for assaying.

standards.title: Assaying and Hallmarking Centre - Requirements for Recognition
standards.scope_description: Requirements that an assaying and hallmarking centre must satisfy to be recognised by BIS for assaying and hallmarking of gold and silver jewellery and artefacts, covering premises, testing equipment, reference materials, competence of assayers, test methods for determination of fineness, marking equipment, record keeping and quality system.

standards.title: Silver and Silver Alloy Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking
standards.scope_description: Requirements for the fineness grades of silver and silver alloys used in jewellery and artefacts and the corresponding hallmarking requirements, including the BIS standard mark, fineness number, assaying and hallmarking centre identification mark and jeweller identification mark, with permissible tolerance on declared fineness.

standards.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for high strength deformed steel bars and wires used as reinforcement in concrete, covering the Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, Fe 600 and the corresponding D and S grades, chemical composition limits including carbon, sulphur and phosphorus, mechanical properties comprising yield stress, tensile strength, elongation and bend and rebend tests, rib geometry and spacing, tolerance on nominal mass, and marking of bundles.

standards.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for hot rolled structural steel plates, strips, shapes, sections, flats and bars in grades E250 to E650 used in structural steelwork, bridges, transmission towers and general fabrication, covering steel making process, chemical composition, carbon equivalent and weldability, tensile properties, bend and impact toughness requirements at specified temperatures, and dimensional tolerances.

standards.title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
standards.scope_description: Code of practice for the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings and civil engineering works, covering materials and testing, concrete mix proportioning and grades, durability and exposure conditions, nominal cover to reinforcement, workability, formwork, assembly of reinforcement, transporting, placing, compaction and curing of concrete, and limit state design of reinforced concrete members.

standards.title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for coarse and fine aggregate obtained from natural sources, manufactured sand, iron slag and recycled concrete aggregate for use in concrete and mortar, covering quality and grading limits, permissible limits of deleterious materials, soundness, flakiness and elongation indices, water absorption, alkali aggregate reactivity, and sampling and testing frequency.

standards.title: Concrete Mix Proportioning - Guidelines
standards.scope_description: Guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes, covering the data required for mix proportioning, target mean strength and standard deviation, selection of water cement ratio, water content and admixture dosage, estimation of coarse and fine aggregate proportions, trial mixes and adjustment, and illustrative examples for normal, high strength, self compacting and pumpable concrete.

standards.title: Metallic Materials - Tensile Testing, Part 1: Method of Test at Room Temperature
standards.scope_description: Test method specifying the procedure for tensile testing of metallic materials at room temperature, covering shape and dimensions of test pieces, determination of original cross sectional area and gauge length, testing rate, and determination of upper and lower yield strength, proof strength, tensile strength, percentage elongation after fracture and percentage reduction of area.

standards.title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for industrial safety helmets worn to protect the head of workers against impact and penetration from falling objects, covering helmet shell and harness materials and construction, mass, vertical clearance and wearing height, shock absorption and penetration resistance tests, resistance to water absorption, flammability and electrical insulation, and marking.

standards.title: Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for protective helmets for riders and pillion riders of two wheeled motor vehicles, covering helmet construction and materials, extent of protection, field of vision, shock absorption and penetration resistance, retention system strength and effectiveness, rigidity, projections, visor requirements, and labelling and marking of helmets.

standards.title: Stainless Steel Utensils - Specification
standards.scope_description: Specification for stainless steel utensils used for cooking, serving and storage of food, covering the grades of stainless steel permitted, thickness of sheet, dimensions and capacity, finish, freedom from sharp edges, corrosion resistance test, and marking of utensils. Covered by a Quality Control Order making conformity and the Standard Mark mandatory.
